# Microsoft Edge WebView2 SDK 1.0.3856.49 (binaries)

Unmodified, Microsoft-signed files from the Microsoft.Web.WebView2 NuGet package (lib/net462 and
runtimes/win-x64/native), taken from the pywebview 6.2.1 wheel on PyPI because nuget.org is not reachable
from the build environment. Authenticode: signed by Microsoft Corporation (Microsoft Code Signing PCA 2011);
the message digests match the files. SHA-256 in SHA256SUMS. License: Microsoft WebView2 SDK license (redistributable).
